about: How loot scales through the Lands Between so Fortnite guns keep up with Elden Ring's enemies. A gun's Elden Ring damage = weapons.damage[rarity] x damage_mult of the tier it was found in. Tier is picked from the Site of Grace map area (ER map id prefix m10..m61) the chest is in. rarity_weights = [common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary] for chest weapon rolls.

columns.name: where
columns.map_areas: map ids in this tier: mAA or mAA_BB (legacy dungeons/underground), or m60_X0-X1_Z0-Z1 (open-world tile ranges); first match wins
columns.enemy_hp_hint: typical field-enemy HP there (design note, for balance)
